# @zone: Housing
# @author: generated by tools/gen_garden_bot.py
# @format: expertmode
# @description: Logs where your mouse is relative to the rug and where each new soil lands. Do it by hand.

block wait_world {
    times 40 {
        if any windowvisible ['WorldView'] {
            break
        }
        sleep 0.25
    }
    if not any windowvisible ['WorldView'] {
        log '[M] ERROR: WorldView not visible after 10s - stopping. Last step logged above shows where'
        kill
    }
}
log '[M] === Soil placement measure: do things by hand for about 210 seconds ==='
call wait_world
times 420 {
    mass clickentity '?HOUSE_PA_RedGoldRug'
    sleep 0.5
}
log '[M] measure finished'
kill
